text: @claude How long does the Gatwick Express take from Gatwick airport to London Victoria, and roughly what does a single ticket cost?

The Gatwick Express is non-stop and takes about 30 minutes to Victoria, with trains roughly every 15 minutes. Sources disagree on the single fare. Most say about £20 to £24, and one older page says £16.90. Southern and Thameslink trains take about 30 to 45 minutes and cost roughly £10 to £11 off-peak, so they're cheaper. Check National Rail for the current fares.

Sources: [Trip.com](https://uk.trip.com/trains/uk/companies/gatwick-express/), [Trainline](https://www.thetrainline.com/train-times/london-victoria-to-gatwick-airport), [Top Tip London](https://www.toptiplondon.com/transport/airports/gatwick), [Omio](https://www.omio.com/companies/trains/gatwick-express), [LastTrip](https://lasttrip.uk/blog/cheapest-way-london-to-gatwick.html)

@claude How long does the Luton Airport Express take from Luton airport to London St Pancras, and roughly what does a single cost?

The train from Luton Parkway to St Pancras takes about 25 to 45 minutes, usually around 35 to 40. You also need the shuttle (DART) from the terminal to Parkway, which is a few minutes and about £4.90. I couldn't find a clear current standard single fare. Advance tickets start around £3, and one older page listed about £24. Check Trainline or National Rail for 6 Dec.
